title: openchoreo-observability-plane
description: Platform-owned keys of the openchoreo-observability-plane wrapper. Upstream subchart keys are not constrained; cross-field checks live in templates/validate.yaml.

cluster.description: Injected by the addon ApplicationSet with --set-string, so every value is a string.

openchoreo.description: installation.yaml openchoreo block (valuesObject); subchart hostnames/ports are checked against it in validate.yaml.

orgNamespace.description: OpenChoreo organization namespace; the promotion gate runs in workflows-<orgNamespace>.

host.description: Base domain; observer.<host>, rca-agent.<host> and *.observability.<host> derive from it.

enabled.description: Observability plane installed; false contradicts this addon (validate.yaml).

httpPort.description: Gateway HTTP listener (== k3d published port).

tlsPort.description: Gateway TLS passthrough listener for OpenSearch (== k3d published port).

workflowPlane.description: Workflow plane toggle (gates the Prometheus ingress rule).

prometheusIngress.description: Additive NetworkPolicy letting platform workflows (promotion gate) query Prometheus.

fromPodLabels.description: Labels of platform workflow pods; must not be empty (validate.yaml).

ports.description: Prometheus pod ports (after the Service DNAT).

clusterObservabilityPlane.description: ClusterObservabilityPlane CR rendered by this chart.

agentServerCA.description: Copies the control-plane gateway CA (public cert only) into a ConfigMap for the agent.

secrets.description: ExternalSecrets for OpenSearch credentials and AI agent keys.

store.description: ClusterSecretStore the credentials come from (mgmt: platform).

remoteKey.description: Store key with the OpenSearch credentials.

aiRemoteKey.description: Store key with the AI agent LLM API keys.

openchoreo-observability-plane.description: Upstream openchoreo-observability-plane subchart values (not constrained here).

observability-logs-opensearch.description: Upstream observability-logs-opensearch subchart values (not constrained here).

observability-tracing-opensearch.description: Upstream observability-tracing-opensearch subchart values (not constrained here).

observability-metrics-prometheus.description: Upstream observability-metrics-prometheus subchart values (not constrained here).
